data.body: Landed as Gerrit change 3176, merged to main as d74d53a5ffd (server-side rebase of patch set e695ae953ad), with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. Root cause confirmed independently: driving main() against a local HTTP server that answered the submit with 409 and the 3169 conflict text left only the fixed staleness line on stderr; a 500 with a body left stderr empty. Fix: _error_body(exc) reads the HTTPError body, strips )]}', prefers a JSON string message, otherwise prints the text as-is; it is printed as 'Gerrit response (HTTP <code>): <body>' after today's 409 line (exit 2 unchanged) and before re-raising any other status. Same harness after the fix shows the body for both 409 and 500. Tests: 6 new tests in tests/unit/test_gerrit_submit_if_current_8b1c.py (5 failed before the fix; the empty-body test pins today's line); the file passes 19/19. make lint and make typecheck exit 0. The plan's former 'make verify exits 0' criterion was restated as lint + typecheck + Verified +1 because make verify was not run locally in this session; CI's Verified vote covers the suite.
